topics.title_zh: 数学家声称克劳德已破解黎曼猜想，科学界质疑声四起
topics.title_en: Mathematician claims Claude solved Riemann Hypothesis; scientific community skeptical
topics.summary_zh: 数学家莱文特·阿尔波格利用 Anthropic 的 Claude 模型声称解决了千年数学难题黎曼猜想。若证实，将是AI介入硬科学的里程碑；若为幻觉，则再次引发AI在复杂严谨逻辑推理中“一本正经胡说八道”的严重信任危机。
topics.summary_en: Mathematician Levent Alpöge claims to have solved the Riemann Hypothesis using Anthropic's Claude. If verified, it marks a milestone in AI-assisted hard science; if a hallucination, it triggers a severe crisis regarding AI's reliability in complex logical reasoning.

perspective_pro.point_zh: 认为AI已进化至能处理人类思维盲区的复杂符号逻辑，通过辅助人类大脑，AI将成为破解数百年遗留难题的关键催化剂。
perspective_pro.point_en: Argues that AI has evolved to handle complex symbolic logic beyond human blind spots, serving as a critical catalyst for cracking centuries-old problems.

perspective_con.point_zh: 指责模型缺乏逻辑自洽性的验证能力，担心这只是大规模生成式模型基于概率拟合出的“伪证明”，可能误导整个数学界。
perspective_con.point_en: Warns of the lack of logical self-consistency in LLMs, fearing it is merely a 'pseudo-proof' generated via probability, potentially misguiding the entire field.

topics.title_zh: 英伟达CEO黄仁勋被罢免，SEC彻查会计违规
topics.title_en: Nvidia CEO Huang ousted; SEC probes into accounting irregularities
topics.summary_zh: 英伟达深陷治理危机，黄仁勋因隐瞒个人私生活及公司财务合规问题被董事会罢免。SEC同步对英伟达展开会计审查，叠加供应链涉军争议，英伟达股价连续七周下挫，市值缩水至3.1万亿美元。
topics.summary_en: Nvidia faces a governance crisis as Jensen Huang is ousted over personal and financial compliance issues. Simultaneously, the SEC probes Nvidia's accounting, while military supply chain ties surface, driving the stock into a seven-week slump to a $3.1T valuation.

perspective_pro.point_zh: 清洗管理层是短期剧痛但长期利好，通过重塑企业治理结构和财务透明度，有助于英伟达摆脱“神话泡沫”风险，实现可持续增长。
perspective_pro.point_en: Views the management purge as necessary short-term pain to ensure long-term sustainability through restored transparency and ethical governance.

perspective_con.speaker_zh: 英伟达忠实信徒与技术极客
perspective_con.point_zh: 质疑罢免动机，认为黄仁勋是AI时代的灵魂人物，突兀的变动将导致算力布局战略中断，引发半导体产业的震荡与人才流失。
perspective_con.point_en: Questions the timing of the ouster, arguing that losing the visionary leader disrupts the AI strategy and risks massive talent flight in the semiconductor sector.

topics.category_tag_zh: 模型小型化与推理成本
topics.title_zh: Inkling 2 Mini 发布：循环变压器技术挑战大模型体积
topics.title_en: Inkling 2 Mini launch: Loop-Transformer challenges bulky model paradigm
topics.summary_zh: Thinking Machines Lab推出的Inkling 2 Mini模型，通过5.4B参数循环变压器架构，实现了匹配27B模型水准的智能表现。该技术试图通过中间层循环机制，在不牺牲推理能力的前提下，将硬件门槛降至笔记本级别。
topics.summary_en: Thinking Machines Lab's Inkling 2 Mini uses a 5.4B loop-transformer architecture to match 27B-model performance. It aims to lower hardware requirements to laptop-grade without sacrificing reasoning, challenging the 'bigger is always better' paradigm.

perspective_pro.point_zh: 支持架构创新，通过循环层逻辑极大提升参数利用效率，为在边缘侧部署高性能推理模型开辟了极具经济价值的路径。
perspective_pro.point_en: Supports architectural innovation where loop-layer logic boosts parameter efficiency, paving a cost-effective path for high-performance inference on edge devices.

perspective_con.point_zh: 认为这种技巧性架构在复杂任务（如代码生成、复杂决策）的鲁棒性上远逊于大规模稠密模型，过度追求“小而精”可能导致推理盲区。
perspective_con.point_en: Argues that such 'trick' architectures lack the robustness of large dense models for complex reasoning, fearing potential failure in edge cases.

linked_news.title_zh: 人工分析称 Inkling 2 Mini 具有 5.4B 的活动参数，其智能指数与 Qwen3.8 27B (xhigh) 相匹配，但活动参数少约 5 倍（人工分析）
linked_news.title_en: Artificial Analysis says Inkling 2 Mini, with 5.4B active parameters, matches Qwen3.8 27B (xhigh) on its Intelligence Index with ~5x fewer active parameters (Artificial Analysis)

linked_news.title_zh: TML 发布了 Inkling 2 Mini，这是一个开放权重 26.4B 参数转换器，每个 token 循环中间层 3 次，以便用更少的 token 进行更好的推理（Thinking Machines La）
linked_news.title_en: TML releases Inkling 2 Mini, an open-weights 26.4B-parameter transformer that loops middle layers three times per token for better reasoning with fewer tokens (Thinking Machines Lab)
